title: AI Tools - native preview
preview: Preview only: portable PicoClaw, Hermes Desktop AppImage and Codex CLI, plus Hermes Desktop system DEB installation. Hermes Agent, Ollama and Codex Desktop remain Pending; the production AI plugin is unchanged.
status: Portable receipts and system operation journal
system_scope: System DEB install only, Linux amd64. APT may install or upgrade Hermes Desktop and dependencies and execute package scripts/triggers as root, which may affect services and desktop integration. Administrator configuration is not rewritten. Nonempty preferences or custom preference paths are refused because local DEB installs can bypass pins. No removal, forced downgrade or ownership adoption.
system_consent: Requires CORE confirmation plus --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. The download trusts fathah/hermes-desktop GitHub HTTPS release metadata and its SHA-256, not an independent signature. Uses trusted literal commands via sudo -n; authenticate separately in a terminal if policy requires it. ATM never reads passwords. This offline menu does not resolve releases, query packages or verify sudo access.
system_install: Install latest system DEB (trust download and APT side effects)
system_custom: Install exact system DEB (trust download and APT side effects)
system_no_journal: Hermes Desktop system: no ATM operation journal; installed package state is not queried by this view.
system_journal: Hermes Desktop system: recorded operation only, not live package status
system_complete: Hermes Desktop system package verified installed. Package-manager ownership retained; application not launched. User settings and portable installations were not adopted.
uninstall: Remove all owned preview versions (keep user data)
trust: Download consent trusts the named upstream executable and its GitHub release SHA-256 metadata. This is not an independent signature. ATM does not run it, install dependencies, change PATH or configure services.
appimage: AppImage runtime dependencies (including compatible FUSE when required) must be installed separately. ATM does not execute or extract the AppImage runtime.
preserved: Manual and legacy installations, models, credentials, settings and profiles are not adopted or removed. Versions reported here come only from private preview receipts.
